title: FrameManager (one frame at a time)
desc: Opens one frame at a time with a slide-up tween; buttons wired as Open/Close/Toggle.

title: UI initializer with name-based button binding
desc: Hides frames on boot, binds HUD buttons to frames by name, hover/press animations, opens menus from pads or by distance.

title: HUD stats controller
desc: Syncs HUD labels with leaderstats and wires product, random-item and invite buttons with button animations.

title: HUD panel pop (UIScale)
desc: HUD buttons pop panels open/closed by tweening a UIScale, one panel at a time, reset on respawn.

title: Single open ScreenGui handler
desc: Disables the other listed ScreenGuis whenever one becomes enabled.

title: Global window pop-in effect
desc: Watches every Main/Window/Panel frame and pops it in from 80% scale when shown.

title: UI router (module per screen)
desc: Loads every UI module, runs init/start, and opens/closes screens by name with one open at a time.

title: FrameAnimator (blur, FOV, HUD slide)
desc: Full frame manager with size/fade tweens, blur, FOV zoom, HUD sliding off-screen and button/part triggers.

title: HUD slide off-screen by area
desc: Slides HUD edge groups off-screen when the player leaves home, using a manual Heartbeat lerp.

title: UIStroke screen scaler
desc: Scales every UIStroke thickness by screen width relative to 1920 px.

title: GUI helpers (open frame + FOV)
desc: Open a frame with slide and FOV tween while closing others, loading overlay, text popups, alert.

title: Hide/show HUD groups
desc: Slides the left, right and bottom HUD groups off-screen and back.

title: Side buttons toggle frames
desc: Side buttons slide on hover and toggle the same-named frame; close buttons wired on every frame.

title: GUI indexer + mouse unlock
desc: Indexes every ScreenGui child by name and provides a Modal button to free the mouse in first person.

title: GuiManager widget framework
desc: Registers windows and widgets (tabs, sliders, toggles, dropdowns, lists, radial menu) and closes all windows.

title: Gamepad-aware Window class
desc: Tweened show/hide, blur, cancel/B to close, per-window gamepad actions and selection focus.

title: TabGroup class
desc: Keeps one tab pressed, fires TabChanged, cycles tabs with L1/R1.

title: Tab button class
desc: Single tab button used by TabGroup with pressed/unpressed styles.

title: Dropdown menu widget
desc: Expandable option list that fires opened/selected events.

title: Gamepad radial menu
desc: Picks one of six wedges from the thumbstick angle.

title: Slider widget
desc: Draggable 0-1 slider for mouse, touch and gamepad.

title: WindowManager (pattern)
desc: One-open-at-a-time windows with optional stack/Back, UIScale pop, blur, HUD hiding, gamepad B close, auto-binding.

title: DeviceScaler (pattern)
desc: UIScale per ScreenGui by screen size plus PC/Touch/Gamepad detection with a change event.

title: TabGroup (pattern)
desc: Tab buttons and pages matched by name, one selected, Changed event, L1/R1 cycling.

title: InputBinder (pattern)
desc: Keyboard/gamepad keys bound to UI actions with conditions, typing guard, per-device key hints and touch buttons.
